verdicts.decision_note: First concrete layout-feasibility failure: the required main-board content cannot fit within the supplied dimensions.
The client establishes implementation-relevant board orientation, top-edge connector placement, interboard alignment, and cable-routing constraints.
The client makes prototype board dimensions flexible and specifies enclosure order, vertical mounting, top cable access, and permitted side placement for smaller connectors.
The client replaces the flexible-size policy with a 140×100 mm outline and requires individual JST connectors and edge placement of the ESP32.
The client changes the physical connector implementation from L-shaped parts to straight connectors pointing away from the board.
The client confirms that the design now uses only one board, removing the separate main-board layout requirement; integrated-board constraints must not be stored as its values.

missing_event_candidates.description: The client requires minimizing components on the inaccessible bottom side of the vertically mounted board.
The client specifies integrated-board battery, USB-C, display-connector, antenna-orientation, antenna-keepout, and general connector-placement constraints.
